review_evidence: Item-by-item review for nested-place meaning, location accuracy, singular-plural agreement, fresh independent and assessment contexts, deterministic masterclass answers, and flexible writing evaluation.
title: This is My Town
source_note: Aligned to the NCERT chapter title and themes of towns, streets, houses, rooms, objects, and location language. All Zidd scenes, maps, prompts, and feedback are original.

levels.title: Follow places from big to small
levels.focus: understand how a street, house, room, and object fit inside one another
levels.teaching_goal: Trace nested locations and answer where an object or person is found.

guided_check.teaching_block: Places can fit inside larger places: a room is in a house, and a house is on a street. Follow the chain one link at a time. Do not skip straight from the town to the smallest object.
guided_check.passage: In Sun Town, Rose Street has a yellow house. The house has a reading room.
options: in the yellow house
on Rose Street only
inside Sun Town hall

bridge.teaching_block: Keep each location connected to the next. The object belongs in the room named just before it.
bridge.passage: A flat stands on Lake Road. In the flat is a kitchen. A blue jug is on the kitchen shelf.
options: on the kitchen shelf
under Lake Road
inside a street

masterclass.teaching_block: Two objects may be in different rooms. Match the object to its own chain, not to the first room mentioned.
masterclass.passage: Maya's home has a bedroom and a study. Her pillow is on the bedroom cot; her atlas is on the study desk.
options: on the bedroom cot
on the study desk
under the house

independent_check.teaching_block: Answer without choices. Follow the place chain backward from the object.
independent_check.passage: A lane leads to a courtyard. The courtyard has a shed. Rohan's red bicycle is inside the shed.

transfer_check.teaching_block: Use nested-place reading in a market, not a home. Identify the exact location, not only the larger area.
transfer_check.passage: The fair has a food row. A juice stall stands in that row, and a water drum is behind the stall.
accepted_answers: at the back of the juice stall

levels.title: Choose exact position words
levels.focus: use in, on, under, beside, and behind to describe location
levels.teaching_goal: Select and use position words that match a clear spatial relationship.

guided_check.teaching_block: Position words tell how two things are placed. In means inside; on means touching the top. Look at the picture made by the sentence.
guided_check.passage: The marbles are inside a glass jar.
guided_check.prompt: Which position word completes: The marbles are ___ the jar?
options: in
on
behind

bridge.teaching_block: Check whether the object touches the top or is lower than it. Under and on describe opposite positions.
bridge.passage: A folded blanket rests on top of the wooden chest.
bridge.prompt: Which word fits the blanket's position?
options: under
on
beside

masterclass.teaching_block: Use the viewpoint in the sentence. Behind means at the back; beside means next to.
masterclass.passage: The small clinic stands at the back of the town library.
masterclass.prompt: Which word best describes the clinic?
options: beside the library
behind the library
inside the library

independent_check.teaching_block: Name the position word from the relationship. Give only the word or a short phrase.
independent_check.passage: A lamp and a clock stand next to each other on the table.
independent_check.prompt: Where is the lamp in relation to the clock?

transfer_check.teaching_block: Apply position words to a playground plan. Use the bench as the reference point.
transfer_check.passage: The drinking-water tap is directly below the shade roof and next to the green bench.
transfer_check.prompt: Where is the tap in relation to the bench?

levels.title: Say what a place has
levels.focus: use there is for one and there are for more than one
levels.teaching_goal: Build accurate place sentences with singular and plural naming words.

guided_check.teaching_block: Use there is for one thing and there are for two or more. Count the naming word before choosing. Do not let a plural place name change the count.
guided_check.passage: The square has one clock tower.
guided_check.prompt: Which arrangement makes a clear location sentence?
options: There is a clock tower in the square.
There are a clock tower in the square.
There is two towers in the square.
accepted_answers: There is a clock tower in the square.
there is one clock tower in the square

bridge.teaching_block: Look for the plural ending and the number word. More than one needs there are.
bridge.passage: Three buses wait near the depot.
options: There is three buses near the depot.
There are three buses near the depot.
There are one bus near the depot.
accepted_answers: There are three buses near the depot.
there are buses near the depot

masterclass.teaching_block: A sentence may name one group but several things. Count the things after there is or there are.
masterclass.passage: The garden contains a pond and four benches.
options: There is four benches by the pond.
There are four benches by the pond.
There are a pond by four bench.
accepted_answers: There are four benches by the pond.

independent_check.teaching_block: Complete the sentence without choices. Match the verb to the plural noun.
independent_check.passage: Near the station, ___ two bicycle stands.
independent_check.prompt: Complete the nature-centre sentence with two words.

transfer_check.teaching_block: Use the same number agreement in a nature centre.
transfer_check.passage: Inside the glass case, ___ one large shell.

levels.title: Build a location sentence
levels.focus: put place words in an order that makes location clear
levels.teaching_goal: Arrange naming, action, and position words into clear town sentences.

guided_check.teaching_block: A clear location sentence usually names the thing, gives is or are, then tells the place. Keep position words beside the place phrase they introduce.
guided_check.passage: Words: the / is / bank / market / beside / the
options: The bank is beside the market.
Beside is the bank the market.
The market beside the is bank.
accepted_answers: The bank is beside the market.
the bank is beside the market

bridge.teaching_block: Begin with the thing being described, not with a loose naming word. Then add the exact position phrase.
bridge.passage: Words: two / are / trees / gate / near / the
options: Two trees are near the gate.
Near two are the trees gate.
The gate are near two trees.
accepted_answers: Two trees are near the gate.
two trees are near the gate

masterclass.teaching_block: Check both grammar and meaning. One basket needs is, and the location phrase must stay together.
masterclass.passage: Words: a / is / basket / bed / under / the
options: A basket are under the bed.
A basket is under the bed.
Under a is basket the bed.
accepted_answers: A basket is under the bed.
the basket is under the bed

independent_check.teaching_block: Arrange the words into one sentence. Add a capital letter and full stop if you can.
independent_check.passage: Words: our / has / town / wide / streets

transfer_check.teaching_block: Build a sentence about a farmyard, away from the town setting.
transfer_check.passage: Words: the / hens / are / behind / barn / the
accepted_answers: the hens are behind the barn
the hens are behind the barn.

levels.title: Describe a neighbourhood clearly
levels.focus: write connected details about places and positions
levels.teaching_goal: Create a concise description with a place, feature, and exact location word.

guided_check.teaching_block: A useful description names the area and places one feature clearly. Choose the sentence that helps a listener picture the neighbourhood.
guided_check.passage: Map note: library on King Street; park opposite it.
guided_check.prompt: Which sentence describes the map accurately?
options: The park is opposite the library on King Street.
The park is inside every library.
King Street is a book.
accepted_answers: The park is opposite the library on King Street.
the park is opposite the library

bridge.teaching_block: Combine two map facts without losing either location. Check each position word against the note.
bridge.passage: Map note: clinic beside bus stop; fruit shop behind clinic.
options: The clinic is beside the bus stop, and the fruit shop is behind the clinic.
The clinic is behind the fruit shop and bus stop.
The fruit shop is inside the bus.
accepted_answers: The clinic is beside the bus stop, and the fruit shop is behind the clinic.
the clinic is next to the bus stop and the fruit shop is behind it

masterclass.teaching_block: A complete town description needs accurate number words as well as position words. Reject a sentence that changes one shop into many.
masterclass.passage: Scene: one bakery on Hill Lane; two benches outside it.
masterclass.prompt: Which sentence is complete and correct?
options: There is a bakery on Hill Lane, and there are two benches outside it.
There are a bakery and one bench on Hill Lane.
The bakery is under two lanes.
accepted_answers: There is a bakery on Hill Lane, and there are two benches outside it.
there is one bakery on hill lane with two benches outside

independent_check.teaching_block: Write from a new mini-map. Include both places and their relationship. Any clear complete sentence is acceptable.
independent_check.passage: Mini-map: health centre on River Road; pharmacy beside the health centre.
independent_check.prompt: Describe the mini-map in one sentence.

concept_slots.description: Names the health centre and River Road.
any_of: river road has a health centre

concept_slots.description: Places the pharmacy beside the health centre.
any_of: pharmacy is beside the health centre
pharmacy next to the health centre

transfer_check.teaching_block: Transfer place description to a classroom plan. Include the number and both positions without inventing extra objects.
transfer_check.passage: Classroom plan: one globe on teacher's table; three charts behind the table.
transfer_check.prompt: Write one or two clear sentences.

concept_slots.description: States that one globe is on the teacher's table.
any_of: one globe on the teacher's table
a globe is on the teacher's table

concept_slots.description: States that there are three charts.
Places the charts behind the table.

items.passage: In Cedar Town, a lane has a blue house. The house has a balcony with two pots.
options: on the balcony
in the lane
under the town

items.passage: A school contains a hall. A stage stands at the front of the hall, and a drum is on the stage.
options: on the stage
outside the school
behind the hall

items.passage: A museum has a toy room. A wooden train is inside a case in that room.
The market has a flower row. A bucket is under the last flower table.
A red mat lies flat on top of the floor.
options: on
in
behind

items.passage: The cycle stand is at the side of the post office.
items.prompt: Which phrase means at the side of?
options: beside
inside
above

items.passage: The cat sleeps lower than the bench, with the seat above it.
The notice board is fixed at the back of the guard's chair.
The pond has one small island.
items.prompt: Choose the sentence that matches one island.
options: There is one island in the pond.
There are one island in the pond.
There is three islands in the pond.
accepted_answers: There is one island in the pond.
there is an island in the pond

items.passage: Five lamps hang across the street.
items.prompt: Choose the sentence that matches five lamps.
options: There are five lamps across the street.
There is five lamps across the street.
There are one lamp across the street.
accepted_answers: There are five lamps across the street.

items.passage: At the bus stop, ___ one empty seat.
items.prompt: Complete the sentence about the single seat.

items.passage: Near the pond, ___ six ducks.
items.prompt: Complete the sentence about all six ducks.

items.passage: Words: the / shop / is / corner / at / the
items.prompt: Build a clear sentence about the shop.
accepted_answers: the shop is at the corner
the shop is at the corner.

items.passage: Words: three / grow / trees / house / behind / the
items.prompt: Build a clear sentence about the three trees.
accepted_answers: three trees grow behind the house
three trees grow behind the house.

items.passage: Words: a / near / is / station / bridge / the
options: A bridge is near the station.
Near a station the bridge is.
The is bridge station near a.
accepted_answers: A bridge is near the station.
a bridge is near the station

items.passage: Words: our / clean / has / town / parks
items.prompt: Select the clear sentence about the town.
options: Our town has clean parks.
Clean has our parks town.
Parks our town clean has.

items.passage: Map: police post beside the bank; bus shelter opposite both.
options: The police post is beside the bank, and the bus shelter is opposite them.
The police post is inside the bank.
The bus shelter is behind every town.
accepted_answers: The police post is beside the bank, and the bus shelter is opposite them.

items.passage: Scene: one fountain in the square; four seats around it.
options: There is a fountain in the square, with four seats around it.
There are one fountain under four seats.
The square is inside the fountain.
accepted_answers: There is a fountain in the square, with four seats around it.
there is one fountain and four seats around it

items.passage: Mini-map: toy shop on Park Lane; cafe next to toy shop; post box outside cafe.
items.prompt: Describe all three places in one or two sentences.

concept_slots.description: Places the toy shop on Park Lane.
any_of: park lane has a toy shop

concept_slots.description: Places the cafe next to the toy shop.
any_of: cafe next to the toy shop

concept_slots.description: Places the post box outside the cafe.
any_of: outside the cafe is a post box

items.passage: Room plan: one desk by the window; two bags under the desk; a plant on the window ledge.

concept_slots.description: Places one desk by the window.
any_of: one desk is beside the window

concept_slots.description: Places two bags under the desk.
any_of: there are two bags under the desk

concept_slots.description: Places the plant on the window ledge.
any_of: a plant is on the window ledge
